journey.title: Focus stays in the basket dialog after removing a row
journey.goal: Removing the row that holds the focused button keeps keyboard focus inside the trapped dialog

steps.title: Move to the first Remove button

functionalJourney.goal: The basket opens, removes a row and closes

guards.title: Tab wraps inside the basket
guards.goal: Tab from the last Remove button returns to the close button

steps.title: Move backwards to the last Remove button

plan.root_cause: When an item is removed from the basket, the focused element (the remove button) is deleted from the DOM. The focus trap's internal state of tabbable nodes becomes stale, so when focus escapes to the body, the trap cannot accurately restore focus to an element within the basket.
plan.repair_strategy: After removing an item, we update the focus trap's tabbable nodes by calling updateContainerElements on the basket container, ensuring the trap has an accurate set of focusable nodes to restore focus to.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus will remain trapped inside the basket dialog after removing an item, allowing users to continue navigating with the Tab key.
functional_risks: Updating the trap's container elements may cause a brief performance impact, but it is negligible for this small DOM.
verification_requirements: After removing an item, pressing Tab should move focus to the next focusable element within the basket dialog, and the basket dialog should retain focus.

plan.root_cause: When an item is removed from the basket, the focused remove button is deleted from the DOM. The focus trap's internal list of tabbable nodes becomes stale, and the mutation observer may not correctly restore focus because the trap's container elements are not refreshed. Calling `trap.updateContainerElements('#basket')` after removal updates the trap's tabbable nodes and ensures focus can be restored to an element within the basket.
plan.repair_strategy: After removing an item, call `trap.updateContainerElements('#basket')` to refresh the focus trap's tabbable nodes, allowing it to restore focus to the close button or next focusable element within the basket.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard focus will remain trapped inside the basket dialog after removing an item, allowing users to continue navigating with the Tab key.
functional_risks: Updating the trap's container elements may cause a brief performance impact, but it is negligible for this small DOM.
verification_requirements: After removing an item, pressing Tab should move focus to the next focusable element within the basket dialog, and the basket dialog should retain focus.
